name: Hotelier
source:
“The Barkley Hotel & Resort” is one of the most prestigious resorts in all of Miami, Florida, and most interestingly of all… it’s for sale! You play as Greg Newport, a hospitality consultant hired by Helena Barkley (the CEO of “The Barkley Group”) to helm the hotel during its final week before it’s sold to the highest bidder.

How much will the resort sell for?

Will you live up to the expectations of Helena Barkley?

Can you keep her employees from turning it into a madhouse?

Can you even keep the hotel in one piece?

There’s only one way to find out…

“Hotelier” is a hotel management sim & romantic comedy visual novel featuring:
* A charming and often hilarious storyline
* Relaxing jazz and bossa nova soundtrack
* Beautifully drawn sprites
* Elegant hotel and spa setting
* Multiple endings
translation:
“Barkley酒店度假村”是佛罗里达州迈阿密最负盛名的度假村之一。最引人关注的是……它正在出售！你将扮演酒店业顾问Greg Newport，受“Barkley集团”首席执行官Helena Barkley聘请，在酒店卖给出价最高的买家之前，负责掌管最后一周的运营。

度假村最终能卖多少钱？
你能达到Helena Barkley的期望吗？
你能防止员工把这里闹得鸡飞狗跳吗？
甚至，你能让酒店完完整整地撑到最后吗？
答案只有亲自试过才知道……

《Hotelier》是一款结合酒店经营模拟与浪漫喜剧的视觉小说，包含：
·引人入胜、常常令人捧腹的故事；
·轻松的爵士与波萨诺瓦配乐；
·精美的角色立绘；
·典雅的酒店与水疗场景；
·多个结局。
